Our Story Family Owned Since 2013
About MowTown

Local roots.
Professional results.

MowTown Property Maintenance started in 2013 as a one-truck operation in Southeast Michigan. What began with a handful of neighbors trusting us with their lawns has grown into a dedicated team serving over 500 properties across the metro area.

We built this company on a simple idea: show up on time, do the job right, and treat every property like it's our own. Thirteen years later, that hasn't changed — and it's why most of our new customers come through referrals from people we already serve.

We're fully licensed, insured, and committed to practices that are good for your lawn and your community.
